Automated Model Briefing

⚠ AI-generated text — may be wrong, incomplete, or overconfident. This is automated commentary on experimental model output, not flight advice and not a weather forecast. It has not been reviewed by a meteorologist.

Overall Assessment Dry, sharp-thermal day with no precipitation or overdevelopment. Best thermal conditions are at Hallelujah, Slide Mountain, West McClellan, Peavine, and Duck Hill; W/NW flow increases late and makes easterly launches at Kingsbury and Rainbow cross/tail. Low-level shear is present at several sites.

Site Breakdown

  • Kingsbury grade: Marginal — W/NW flow 270–297° crosses the SE launch, with low-level shear. Preferred window 10am–3pm; peak w* 284 ft/min, thermal ceiling 2,503 ft AGL; sharp-thermal caution (lapse rate 9.1 °C/km).
  • Hallelujah: Favorable — best deep thermals and wind alignment; W flow 268–278° on preferred launch. Preferred window 11am–5pm; peak w* 406 ft/min, thermal ceiling 5,687 ft AGL; sharp-thermal caution (9.9 °C/km).
  • Slide Mountain: Favorable — light winds and good early thermals. Preferred window 10am–2pm; peak w* 349 ft/min, thermal ceiling 4,247 ft AGL; sharp-thermal caution (8.7 °C/km).
  • McClellan: Marginal — strong late thermals but W/NW surface wind and low-level shear; prime after 1:30pm. Preferred window 1:30pm–5pm; peak w* 418 ft/min, thermal ceiling 5,020 ft AGL; sharp-thermal caution (9.6 °C/km).
  • West McClellan: Favorable — afternoon wind direction 240–261° near preferred with moderate thermals. Preferred window 1pm–5pm; peak w* 358 ft/min, thermal ceiling 3,889 ft AGL; sharp-thermal caution (9.2 °C/km).
  • Peavine Mountain: Favorable — good thermals with light/modest wind, though surface flow is slightly W of preferred. Preferred window 10am–4pm; peak w* 368 ft/min, thermal ceiling 4,926 ft AGL; sharp-thermal caution (9.4 °C/km).
  • Rainbow Ridge: Marginal — strong thermals but E/NE launch becomes cross/tail with W winds after midday; fly early. Preferred window 10am–1pm; peak w* 399 ft/min, thermal ceiling 3,546 ft AGL; sharp-thermal caution (9.9 °C/km).
  • Duck Hill: Favorable — good thermal peak and usable evening ridge wind. Preferred window 12pm–5pm thermals; peak w* 374 ft/min, thermal ceiling 5,435 ft AGL; evening ridge 6–8pm; sharp-thermal caution (9.8 °C/km).
  • Daydreams: Marginal — very weak thermals, no thermal onset; only brief light SW ridge/soaring window 2–4pm. Peak w* 96 ft/min, thermal ceiling 1,995 ft AGL; sharp-thermal caution (9.3 °C/km).

Hazards

  • Sharp thermals: lapse rates 8.7–9.9 °C/km at listed sites — advanced/expert pilots only.
  • Low-level shear: Kingsbury grade 5 mph at 779 ft AGL, McClellan 5 mph at 250 ft AGL, West McClellan 5 mph at 246 ft AGL, Duck Hill 5 mph at 1,166 ft AGL.
  • Rotor/lee turbulence: possible downwind of Peavine Mtn and Carson Range ridgelines in W/NW flow, especially late day at Kingsbury, Slide, Rainbow, and Duck Hill.

Site Forecast ?Top of Thermals (PBLH) — height of the turbulent mixing layer; thermals typically reach this ceiling.
LCL (Lifted Condensation Level) — altitude where rising air reaches its dew point; theoretical cloud base.
Cloud Base — lowest model level with >10% cloud fraction.
w* — convective velocity scale; higher = stronger thermals (ft/min).
Cloud Cover — max cloud fraction over the column (0–100%).
Wind thresholds: orange = 12 mph, red = 18 mph.
